title: Gas report - Week 40
summary:
LNG
The LNG market experienced a mixed week, with last week's improving sentiment failing to translate into a sustained recovery in spot earnings. The Pacific market proved more resilient, supported by stronger demand and a relatively tighter vessel list. On the BLNG1 Australia-Japan route, rates increased by $1,300 week-on-week to settle at $37,700/day.
